title: Normalized finite constant-complex pullback
statement: Let g:X→Y be any scheme morphism, R a commutative ring, I an ideal, and dY,dX normalized finite towers [def-a1-constant-complex-quotient-model]. There is a finite comparison f [def-a1-constant-complex-base-change-data] whose level isomorphisms preserve pulled constant tensor sections, whose source transition is the pullback of every original transition on arbitrary sections, and whose strict tower isomorphism has the prescribed scalar-restricted level components.

proof.text: Apply the realized scalar pullback comparison at each quotient coefficient. Construct each pulled transition by pulling the original semilinear step, composing the canonical pullback–restriction mate, and restricting along the scalar quotient map. The mate unit equation gives the required formula on every pulled local section. The generator uniqueness statement from the composed adjunctions reduces the consecutive square to constant unit tensors, where both original finite-tower normalizations agree. Form the strict natural tower isomorphism from consecutive squares.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_finite_pullback_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (dY : FiniteTower Y I) (dX : FiniteTower X I)
    (hdY : dY.IsNormalized Y I) (hdX : dX.IsNormalized X I) :
    ∃ f : FiniteComparison g I dY dX, f.IsNormalized g I
